sentences.en: The doctor's quick arrival brought about her very speedy recovery.
sentences.zh: 医生迅速赶到使她很快恢复健康。

sentences.en: Recovery of the world economy is not yet in sight.
sentences.zh: 世界经济复苏尚未出现迹象。

sentences.en: Recall the filename before you try to perform file recovery.
sentences.zh: 在尝试文件恢复之前先回忆一下文件名。

senses.zh: 恢复，康复；复原，重新获得；经济复苏；追回，寻回
